title: Week 4: Unity on Web
content:
Week 4: Unity on Web

I finished watching the Unity Pathway VR and AR part. Because the game jam is coming, I will put the work on hold for a while.

The VR part is what I want. The AR part, because unity AR is relying on mobile, that means I can only make android one. However, I will still do that, but I will try some webXR APIs. Also I will try the 8thWall.

As I am preparing for the game jam, I checked some libraries, like React Unity WebGL. It is used to embed unity webGL exports to react. And also the it allows the communication between C# and js.

This week, I also tried WebGPU support in Unity. To try WebGPU, you need unity 6.1 beta. Then configure the player settings to WebGPU.

TV

Ludwig is a detective story. The character's twin brother is missing, he disguises himself as his brother to investigate it. I only watched the first episode. But it was a fun series to watch.
